heading_path: Buyer's Guide Contract negotiation - How to negotiate
blocks.markdown: How to negotiate It is your responsibility to conduct all negotiations. If the negotiations are of a technical nature, you will work with the client. During negotiations: all offerors must be treated fairly and impartially confidentiality of each offeror's negotiating position must be assured Note: Negotiations should not become an auction where offerors continuously enhance their offers based on insights into their competitors' positions. Upon conclusion, you must include a negotiation report in the procurement file. At a minimum, the report must describe the following elements: date and participants; a summary of the discussions; any changes to the offer; the agreements that were reached; and the final decision.
